message:
docs(release): the content 1408252 described

1408252 is empty. Its message describes the ACL hardening and two
corrections, and the tree it committed contains none of them: the script
writing those edits asserted out on an anchor that no longer matched and
never reached its write, and I staged and committed without looking at the
diff. A commit whose message claims work it does not carry is worse than no
commit, so this one carries it and says where it went.

Contents, as described there: the key folder no longer inherits, three
explicit principals remain, and two things I asserted in #480 are corrected
-- that an unresolvable SID meant a deleted account, and that losing the key
would mean simply signing again with a new one.

Left in place rather than amended. The empty commit is part of what
happened.
